build_forward_model: build a ForwardMap or ResidualForwardMap model using build_forward with obs, z, and action dims
build_backward_model: build a BackwardMap model using build_backward to map goal observations to latent variables
build_actor_model: build an Actor or ResidualActor policy network using build_actor with obs, z, and action dims
soft_update_params: soft update target network parameters from source network using exponential moving average with tau
create_dense_parallel_layer: create a DenseParallel linear layer that processes multiple parallel forward passes in a single batch
